title: Time-source mismatch: local date inside the window, normalized UTC outside it (SYNTHETIC)
scientific_question: Illustrative only (invented): were all synthetic readings taken inside the requested evidence window of May 2026 (UTC)? No real station, logger or observation is involved.
claim_tested: Given a time-sources document whose requested window is 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-05-31T23:59:59Z, and whose event syn-obs-03 is recorded at local time 2026-05-31T22:30:00 with offset -04:00 and an internally consistent normalized UTC of 2026-06-01T02:30:00Z, science-gate verify with a required time_source check reports FAIL with exit code 1, reason SOURCE_MISMATCH and failure modes exactly [SOURCE_MISMATCH], and its report names syn-obs-03 as OUTSIDE_WINDOW. It must not PASS on the local date, which falls inside the window.
falsified_by: The recorded run returning PASS, ABSTAIN or ERROR; an exit code other than 1; a reason other than SOURCE_MISMATCH; failure_modes other than exactly [SOURCE_MISMATCH]; or a report.md that lacks any of the must_mention strings.
